proposed_capability: PS-0241: resilient per-Sim ecology intent, paused planning and live-play proposal reconciliation, verified pickup-before-fertilize, independent need/work budgets and bounded GP-vs-baseline forecasting, without asserting native EA queue authority.
player_save_control_impact: No desktop input, no game queue mutation, no Sim saves or Mods changes, no telemetry daemon. Proposed steps remain gated by native installed verifier and player first.
expected_outcome: Per-Sim serializable goal retained across pause, portrait switches and autonomous distractions; one fresh exact-target proposal at a time; independently witnessed inventory gain before fertilization; deterministic admission and bounded model comparison.
negative_tests: Stale capture and cross-Sim input deny
No independent stock gain means no fertilize
GP rejected when no statistically useful validated improvement
rollback_path: Revert the bounded policy module and tests; no user files or game state modified.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact verified EA game-event/queue/inventory native APIs
Version-matched embedded Python and ts4script import activation
User-host P08 disposable vanilla/modified game proof
decision_rationale: P141 in-scope theses: new desktop click daemon REJECT (does not solve native activation); blanket GP schedule REJECT (uncalibrated discontinuities); direct guessed EA hook REJECT (local provenance missing); bounded reusable intent reducer + native interface gate SELECT as the safest executable base.
